companies.name: Brenner & Sohn Tiefbau GmbH
companies.does: Road construction, sewers and pipelines, earthworks, municipal civil engineering. Owns its own machinery.
companies.placeOfPerformance: Bavaria, mainly Schwaben and Oberbayern, up to ~150 km from Augsburg (crews return home nightly)
companies.exclusions: No rail-side work (no DB qualification, no certified safety staff), no bridges, nothing outside Germany
companies.specifications: Financial limit: bank supports guarantees up to ~€1.5M total outstanding at any one time. Below €400k the overhead isn't worth it; above €5M they would need a partner. Free from March (two crews committed until then). Reference projects: a €2.9M state road rehabilitation, a district sewer renewal, several housing-estate site developments. In their words: 'We're reliable and we're local. We lose on price to the bigger players about half the time. We want the jobs where the client cares that we turn up.'

companies.name: Elektro Vogtland GmbH
companies.does: Electrical installation for buildings — power, lighting, fire alarm systems, building automation. Usually works as a subcontractor to a general contractor.
companies.placeOfPerformance: Saxony, Thuringia, eastern Bavaria, up to ~200 km from Plauen
companies.exclusions: No high voltage work, no explosion-protected installations, cannot act as main contractor on a multi-trade job. In their words: 'We're good but we're small. The paperwork is why most of our work comes through general contractors. If a public job is straightforward, we'll bid it directly.'
companies.specifications: Financial limit: guarantees up to ~€300k. Reference projects: school refurbishments, a hospital ward block, office fit-outs, two care homes.

companies.name: Hanseatische Bau AG
companies.does: Building construction and turnkey projects — offices, schools, hospitals, housing, logistics. They coordinate; the trades are subcontracted.
companies.exclusions: No civil engineering as lead contractor (no roads, sewers, or bridges); nothing in southern Germany in a decade. In their words: 'We're a coordination business. What hurts us is a tender demanding a high share of self-performed work — we're not set up for that.'
companies.specifications: Below €5M the overhead is disproportionate. Constraint is not money but bidding capacity — the estimating department can seriously pursue about three tenders a week. Reference projects: a university building, two school campuses, a hospital extension, large residential quarters.
